name: title
card: THREE RULES FOR LIVING FROM THE LORD'S PRAYER:
text: Three rules for living from the Lord's Prayer:

name: r1
card: 1. Confess all sins to God (Tell it) daily.
text: One. Confess all sins to God (Tell it) daily.

name: r2
card: 2. Surrender your will to God daily.
text: Two. Surrender your will to God daily.

name: r3
card: 3. Forgive others and yourself daily.
text: Three. Forgive others and yourself daily.

name: n1
card: Dear friend, rule 1 is the key to our success.
text: Dear friend, rule one is the key to our success.

name: n2
card: When we can't do rule 2 or 3, we must always go to rule 1 and confess it; God will forgive...
text: When we can't do rule two or three, we must always go to rule one and confess it; God will forgive...

name: n3
card: We must never stop confessing, even if they are the same old sins we can't seem to stop doing.
text: We must never stop confessing, even if they are the same old sins we can't seem to stop doing.

name: n4
card: As we practice these rules everyday...
text: As we practice these rules everyday...

name: n5
card: God will change our lives.
text: God will change our lives.

name: also
card: Also, practice the following little prayer all day:
text: Also, practice the following little prayer all day:

name: dp
card: Lord Jesus, please pour out your mercy, salvation, and deliverance from evil upon everyone I see.
text: Lord Jesus, please pour out your mercy, salvation, and deliverance from evil upon everyone I see.

name: turn
card: See The Other Side Of This Card For More Help.
text: See The Other Side Of This Card For More Help.

name: inv
card: Dear friend, if you're not sure where you'll spend eternity, and you want to know now, please pray this simple prayer from the bottom of your heart; as he heard my prayer, He will hear yours also.
text: Dear friend, if you're not sure where you'll spend eternity, and you want to know now, please pray this simple prayer from the bottom of your heart; as he heard my prayer, He will hear yours also.

name: p1
card: Dear Lord Jesus, I understand I am a sinner; I also believe You died for my sins and Your Father in Heaven raised you from the dead.
text: Dear Lord Jesus, I understand I am a sinner; I also believe You died for my sins and Your Father in Heaven raised you from the dead.

name: p2
card: I simply ask You to have mercy on my life and save my soul.
text: I simply ask You to have mercy on my life and save my soul.

name: p3
card: Come into my heart and my life and take me to Your home someday.
text: Come into my heart and my life and take me to Your home someday.

name: p4
card: In Your Name Lord Jesus I pray and thank You.
text: In Your Name Lord Jesus I pray and thank You.

name: amen
card: Amen.
text: Amen.

name: back
card: For continuous help from God, see other side...
text: For continuous help from God, see other side...
